loadFailed: Trust data could not be loaded. Reload the page and try again.
empty: No employees or work are visible.
title: Trust grows with reviews
intro: One timeline per type of work: the last {count, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}}, the level at the time, and who changed the level and when.
rules: Reviewing key points starts only when you agree, and you can revoke it at any time. One mistake moves that type of work back to reviewing every item. At every level, the points the employee marked and the automatic checks are always shown.
eventRelax: {date} You agreed to review key points
eventReset: {date} Mistake; moved back to reviewing every item by rule
noteSuggestion: Suggestion: {count, plural, one {no mistakes in the last # review} other {no mistakes in the last # reviews}}. Nothing changes until you agree.
noteLight: Reviewing key points. Points, checks and empty fields are still shown.
noteRevoked: Revoked. Every item is reviewed again from the next submission.
noteReset: A mistake while reviewing key points moved this back to reviewing every item. Reviews need to build up again before reviewing key points is suggested.
noteTooFew: {count, plural, one {Fewer than # review so far} other {Fewer than # reviews so far}}, so reviewing key points is not suggested.
noteViewOnly: The level is decided by people who can review. This identity can only view it.
saveFailed: This could not be saved. Try again.
basisSummary: Current basis: the last {count, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}} ({from} to {to})
basisLabel: Reviews behind the suggestion, oldest first
basisOpenLedger: See these reviews in the work ledger
historyProposed: {date} Reviewing key points suggested by rule, based at the time on {count, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}} ({from} to {to})
historyEffective: {date} In effect: first key-points review after agreeing
historyRevoke: {date} {actor} moved back to reviewing every item
historyReset: {date} Mistake while reviewing key points; moved back to reviewing every item by rule: {title}
reportIntro: All reviews for each type of work. Select a row to see those reviews in the work ledger; select a return count to see only returns.
reportFirstPassNote: “Passed first time” counts assignments: those accepted on the first submission out of all assignments. Reviews include resubmissions after a return.
reportLabel: Trust overview by employee and type of work
reportOpenReturned: {reason}: {count}. Show only returns for {employee} · “{workType}” in the work ledger
dotCorrected: Approved; corrected to a mistake on {date}
